Trig Identity Proof, Class 10 board exam: prove (1 + tan A)² + (1 - tan A)² = 2 sec²A without the common mistake of dividing both sides.

• Start from the LHS only and expand both squares
• The 2 tan A terms cancel: LHS = 2 + 2 tan²A
• The trap: never divide both sides by 2, a proof is not an equation
• Take 2 common and use 1 + tan²A = sec²A: LHS = 2 sec²A = RHS
